title: The Old Footbridge
description: Leave the lane, descend into the stream valley, approach the old footbridge, explore above and below it, and enter riverside woodland.

signs.text:
The country lane
Follow the low lane towards the water

The stream valley
The valley narrows around the stream

The bridge approach
Rise onto the old abutment

Above and below the footbridge
Cross the deck · return beneath it for the hidden landing

The riverside wood
The bridge gives way to a sheltered river path
